summary.en: The morph arc: one ink shape climbs a dimension per scene (point, line, plane, solid, interface, console, mark), the accent handed on like a baton.
summary.zh: morph 的骨架：一块墨色形状每场升一维（点、线、面、体、界面、控制台、标志），强调色像接力棒传递。

fits: Developer products whose story is one thing becoming the next: request, response, spec, docs, a running call.
notFor: Data stories; products without a geometric mark.

intent.en: One shape climbs a dimension per scene, so the product reads as one continuous idea.
intent.zh: 一个形状每场升一维，产品读起来是一个连续的想法。

content.en: Scenes for each slot (see the card); the style's look and sound.
content.zh: 每个槽的场景（见卡片）；该风格的样式与声音。

fits.zh: 故事是一样东西变成下一样的开发者产品：请求、响应、规格、文档、一次运行。

notFor.zh: 数据故事；没有几何标志的产品。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead against the original template's scene order and lengths (card, Differs from upstream)
